notes.subject: circumcised with uncircumcision
notes.rationale: MT lacks the 'behold, days come' clause here (it closes v24); versions differ over where the punishment oracle begins and how to render ערלים — 'uncircumcised in flesh' vs 'uncircumcised in heart'.

notes.subject: ערלים / ערלי לב
notes.rationale: Parallelism: nations uncircumcised in flesh, house of Israel uncircumcised in heart — the repetition of ערל is the verse's rhetorical point and lands as judgment on Israel itself.

notes.subject: קצוצי פאה
notes.rationale: Literal 'cut-off of corner/side-hair' marks desert tribes by their haircut; rendered as 'katim short ol kona bilong het' to keep the literal picture.

notes.subject: bel
notes.rationale: לב rendered 'bel' per Tok Pisin usage for heart/mind/will, not the bodily organ lewa.

translation: Long Mitsrayim, na long Yehuda, na long Edom, na long ol pikinini bilong Amon, na long Moab, na long olgeta man ol i katim ⟨i⟩ short ol kona bilong het, ol i save stap long ples wailman — long wanem, olgeta ol lain ol i no katim skin, na olgeta haus bilong Yisrael, ol i no katim bel.
